roadmap.title: Quick wins
roadmap.description: Easy one-off actions and the free Santa's Sweatshop starters.

roadmap.title: Stat and counter grinds
roadmap.description: Train, fight, dig and work through the counter achievements.

roadmap.title: Favours, money and crew
roadmap.description: Long running favour, cash, recruit and job goals.

roadmap.title: Planned escapes and DLC setup
roadmap.description: Single-prison escape challenges and DLC item and panel tasks.

roadmap.title: Full escapes
roadmap.description: Finish every prison and the DLC level escapes.

achievements.description: Get your Strength and Speed stat to 100
achievements.summary: Get both Strength and Speed to 100.

steps.text: Train on the gym equipment during free time. @loc{Center Perks} is the easiest prison for this because you have lots of free time and showers nearby.

achievements.summary: Flood 30 toilets.

guide.context: Flooding is random when a toilet is flushed with items in it, and the items you use do not change the odds.

steps.text: Put items in an inmate's toilet, for example their stolen sheet and pillow, and flush it. Repeat until 30 toilets have flooded.

achievements.summary: Hold $1000 or more at one time.

guide.context: You must reach the amount in a single prison without spending it.

steps.text: Take the best job available, do many favours, and keep your spending low until you have $1000.

achievements.summary: Complete 100 favours.

guide.context: Favours are offered at morning roll call, marked by a green exclamation mark over an inmate. They ask you to knock someone out, steal an item, distract the guards at a set time, or find an item.

steps.text: Accept every favour you can. Bring armor, a weapon and medkits for the beating favours.

achievements.summary: Attend 50 prison visits.

steps.text: Sit on the visitation chair in @loc{Center Perks} and wait a few seconds for a visitor. Repeat 50 times.
Quit your job and attend only roll call and visits to finish faster.

achievements.summary: Give away 50 items to inmates or guards.

steps.text: During meals, gift plastic knives, spoons and forks. Stolen pillows and sheets also count as gifts.

achievements.summary: Reach 100 Intellect.

steps.text: Read books and use the computer in a prison whenever you have free time. In @loc{Center Perks} this takes about 2 in-game days.

achievements.summary: Knock out 50 inmates.

steps.text: Fight inmates and accept favours that ask you to beat someone up, which also pays you.

achievements.summary: Knock out 50 guards.

guide.context: Knocking out two or more guards at once triggers a lockdown.

steps.text: Raise your Strength and Speed first, and wear armor.
Knock guards out where few people can see, and take the weapon a guard drops.

achievements.summary: Clear 50 tiles in total.

steps.text: Dig with a shovel or spoon. In @loc{Center Perks} you can dig under your desk at lights out; bring chocolate to restore energy. Escaping @loc{San Pancho} also needs a lot of digging.

achievements.description: Successfully escaped from all six prisons
achievements.summary: Escape from all six prisons.

steps.text: Escape each of the six prisons once.

achievements.summary: Complete the quota on every job.

guide.context: Jobs by prison: @loc{Center Perks} has Metal Shop, Mailman, Janitor and Laundry. @loc{Stalag Flucht} has Gardening, Woodshop, Deliveries and Tailor. @loc{Shankton State Pen} has Kitchen. @loc{Jungle Compound} has Library.

steps.text: Raise Intellect enough to qualify and keep your heat under 50%.
If a job is taken, knock out the worker or tie them up with duct tape, then apply for the job.
Hit the quota once on each of the 10 jobs.

achievements.summary: Recruit 5 or more buddies.

guide.context: Do favours only for the inmates you want, because others may ask you to beat up the one you are courting.

steps.text: Raise an inmate's opinion of you with favours, gifts such as comb shivs and chocolate, or money ($10 is about 1%). Aim for 100.
Press @mechanic{Q} (default key) near the inmate to recruit them. Recruit five of them at once.

achievements.description: Drop the soap in the shower.
achievements.summary: Drop your bar of soap during the shower period.

steps.text: Keep the soap from your desk with you until @mechanic{Shower} time, then drop it from your inventory while in the showers.

achievements.summary: Strip the outfits off 50 knocked-out characters.

guide.context: Guards shout at you when you strip inmates.

steps.text: Take the outfit from any inmate who is knocked out. You do not have to knock them out yourself.

achievements.description: Initiate a prison takeover using nunchuks
achievements.summary: Start a prison takeover with nunchucks.

steps.text: Craft @item{Nunchucks} (2 timber, 1 wire) and a plated prisoner outfit (prisoner outfit, sheet of metal, duct tape). Raise Strength and recruit buddies first.
At a meal, attack the guards with the nunchucks. Keep attacking guards until a letter from the warden arrives.
Bind one guard or inmate and carry them through the white door at the main entrance.

achievements.description: Escape a prison with 0% average heat
achievements.summary: Escape a prison with 0% average guard heat.

guide.context: Restarting the day after heat rises is allowed.

steps.text: Collect 8 forks and craft: 2 magazines (each from a poster and duct tape), flimsy cutters (2 files plus 1 duct tape) and a bed dummy (2 pillows plus 1 bed sheet). Buy items instead of stealing them.
Never hit anyone, attend roll call and be where you should be. Use bed sheets to cover cells while looting.
Chip two walls in your cell with forks, covering the holes with magazines.
On escape night, put the dummy in bed, leave through the holes, go outside at 23:00 and cut a north or northeast fence.

achievements.description: Escape a prison on the first day
achievements.summary: Break out of any prison before the first day ends.

guide.context: This is luck-based. @loc{Center Perks} with its standard escape is the advised prison.

steps.text: Collect 4 forks and the parts for flimsy cutters (2 files plus 1 duct tape) and a bed dummy (2 pillows plus 1 bed sheet). Search desks after first roll call for files and duct tape.
Chip the wall below the roll-call area with forks until it reaches 4%, then stop.
Raise Intellect to 40, take the Laundry job and get a clean guard outfit after the quota. Wear it to pass the contraband detector, then change back.
After evening roll call, craft the cutters and lay the bed dummy in your bed.
At exactly 23:00 finish the wall with a fork, put on the guard outfit, go south to the fence, cut it and leave before midnight.

achievements.description: Fill 13 or more pages in your crafting journal
achievements.summary: Fill 13 or more pages of the crafting journal.

guide.context: Buying a recipe note and then reloading the day loses that progress.

steps.text: Craft items, buy crafting notes and loot notes from desks until 13 pages are filled.

achievements.summary: Give the Sovereign Ring to Cage.

steps.text: Find the @item{Sovereign Ring} in the empty cells, then give it to @npc{Cage}.

achievements.summary: Give the Aftershave to Andy.

steps.text: Find the @item{Aftershave} in the empty cells, then give it to @npc{Andy}.

achievements.summary: Give the Trash Bag to Sean.

steps.text: Find the @item{Trash Bag} in the empty cells, then give it to @npc{Sean}.

achievements.summary: Finish building the Tank.

guide.context: If a guard spots you, restart the day.

steps.text: Raise your Strength first, then knock out a guard to take a fuse and a mixing vessel. Collect 3 duct tape.
On the first night, break the wall at the marked spot with 4 forks. Take 2 pipes, 2 corrugated iron and 1 cone.
Craft the tank turret and fit it to the tank.
On later nights, break walls for fertilizer, potassium and coal. Craft a shell and napalm, then use the shell on the tank.

achievements.summary: Escape together with the Escape Team.

steps.text: Build the Tank, recruit the Escape Team, use the napalm, then escape the prison together with them.

achievements.description: Every Escape Team member loves you when you escape.
achievements.summary: Escape with all Escape Team members at 100% opinion of you.

guide.context: The gates close the day after, so do not delay the escape.

steps.text: Before escaping, raise the team's opinion to 100 with gifts or cash ($10 is about 1%).
Recruit the team, use the napalm and escape with them.

achievements.summary: Activate the voice analyzer control panel.

guide.context: Rename the guards by number to track who holds which key: 1 yellow key, 2 orange key and a cassette, 3 purple key and a cassette, 4 red key, 5 green key.

steps.text: Make a fake red key from a mould of guard 4.
Take the cassette player from the main room, and a memory cassette from guard 2 or 3.
Craft the voice recording and use it on the panel.

achievements.summary: Activate the keycard control panel.

steps.text: Get a minion outfit, enter their barracks and take the keycard, then use it on the panel.

achievements.summary: Activate the fingerprint reader control panel.

steps.text: Take the Woodshop and Metal Shop jobs to get duct tape and blue putty.
Make a fake orange key from guard 2, and get a tool that can break a wall.
Break the wall to get a dirty glass, then craft the fake fingerprints and use them on the panel.

achievements.description: Read the instructions for the rocket.
achievements.summary: Read the rocket's instructions.

steps.text: Click the shining board.

achievements.summary: Sit in the villain's chair.

steps.text: After night roll call, go into the bridge room and sit in the chair.

achievements.summary: Escape the Duct Tapes are Forever level.

guide.context: All three panels must be green for the escape to work.

steps.text: Activate the keycard, voice analyzer and fingerprint reader panels, then escape.

achievements.summary: Place presents under the Christmas tree.

steps.text: Knock out an elf guard and take their elf outfit; a bought guard outfit does not work.
Wear the elf outfit only to open the doors, and take two items inside (which two is not confirmed).
Knock out the current Toymaker and take over that job.
At the next roll call, click the tree to see a toy recipe.
Craft the gift at work and put it under the tree.

achievements.summary: Decorate the Christmas tree with tinsel.

steps.text: Find toilet paper and glue, and take 4 forks.
After evening roll call, go to the marked spot, craft the tinsel and hang it on the tree.

achievements.description: Dress the tree with fairy lights.
achievements.summary: Decorate the Christmas tree with fairy lights.

guide.context: The tunnel is found in the morning, so place the lights the same night.

steps.text: Find a battery and wire.

Either make a fake red key, switch off the generator after roll call and cut the fence with wire cutters to reach the chest, or craft a heavy shovel and tunnel under the fence at the third block from the building.
Put the lights on the tree that night.

achievements.summary: Clean up the reindeer mess.

steps.text: Take the cleaning job and clear the mess left by the reindeer.

achievements.description: Hear a child's Christmas wish list.
achievements.summary: Listen to a child's Christmas wish list.

steps.text: Sit in the visitor chair and let the child finish speaking.

achievements.summary: Escape the Santa's Sweatshop level.

steps.text: Break the wall unseen, take the lever, place it and leave the level.
